dct_description_sm: Point feature displaying sanitary manholes. Manhole types include: cleanout, drop manhole, MH chamber, SAMP, vent manhole, and vertical bend. These are placed along sanitary mains allowing access to inspect and routinely clean pipes along the City's sanitary network. Updated as an ongoing process.
